basic_info.description: This hidden Victorian gem, tucked away from the street and surrounded by lush greenery, offers timeless San Francisco elegance paired with sleek modern updates; a true urban retreat just moments from the best of city living. Step inside to soaring ceilings, huge windows, and gorgeous period details: wide plank softwood floors, intricate moldings, wainscoting, and stone hearth and mantel. Dappled light filters through mature trees and stately bay windows into the expansive living room. The home's two spacious bedrooms offer generous closet space and designer lighting, while the central dining room creates a welcoming heart of the home for daily life or hosting guests. The updated kitchen - complete with a breakfast nook, stone counters, tile backsplash, and modern stainless steel appliances - opens to a secluded and tranquil shared garden. Amenities include an elegant bathroom with modern finishes, in-unit stacked washer/dryer, private storage, Schlage Smart Lock, Nest Smoke + CO Detectors, and 1-car garage parking. This home is an easy walk to Duboce & Dolores Parks, and the world-class dining, cafes, nightlife, and easy commuting options at the cusp of Duboce Triangle, Mission Dolores, and the Castro. Don't miss it - this is truly a special property!
